claim: India's large ledger apps remain loss-making years after reaching scale: OkCredit reported FY25 operating revenue of about 23.3 crore INR against a net loss of about 23.2 crore INR, Khatabook reported FY24 revenue of about 102.7 crore INR while still cutting losses, and both laid off staff (figures from search-result summaries of Inc42 and related reports).
